config.title: Agent Configuration
config.intro: Each agent reads its own config keys. Unknown keys are ignored. Defaults apply when a key is absent. See the help articles for the full schema.
inbox.title: 🤖 Agent Inbox
inbox.intro: Proposals from automated agents waiting on your review. Approving applies the proposal to the underlying record (e.g. creates a maintenance task or merges into an existing one). Rejecting trains the agent — please leave a reason.
inbox.emptyHint: Agents will surface their suggestions here for review.
inbox.rejectReasonLabel: Reason (helps the agent learn — please be specific)
inbox.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Not actually a complaint, was a joke / Already handled offline / Too speculative
knowledge.title: Knowledge Base
knowledge.intro: Knowledge entries ground the agents' reasoning. Scope determines visibility: GLOBAL applies everywhere, REGIONAL matches your region bucket, TENANT is your club only. More specific scopes win when titles overlap.
knowledge.noEntries: No knowledge entries match these filters.
